title: Disjoint Clan Cluster Counter
statement:
An isolated valley is populated by V settlements numbered 1 to V. There are E bidirectional trade routes connecting certain pairs of settlements.

Two settlements belong to the same cluster if there exists a route (direct or through other settlements) connecting them.

Determine the total number of disconnected settlement clusters (connected components) in the valley.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers V and E.
Next E lines: Two integers u and v indicating a bidirectional trade route between settlement u and v.
outputFormat: Print the total number of connected components.

sampleCases.explanation: No routes; each settlement is its own cluster.
